adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` uses computed property names `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. These expressions evaluate to the same string (very likely `"[object Object]"`), so the second definition overwrites the first. As a result, the intended “any numeric expiry field” validation is effectively lost and, in sync mode, the schema only reliably enforces `access_token` while allowing arbitrary other fields. This is a concrete correctness defect visible in the diff.
